# Compounding Journey

> Compounding Journey is Sandy Bradbury's multilingual financial education site about money psychology, intentional investing, compound growth, personal budgeting, and building financial freedom around personal values.

The site is available in Spanish, English, and Portuguese. It provides educational articles, interactive financial calculators, free downloadable Excel templates, information about Sandy Bradbury, and ways to follow or contact the project. The content and tools are general educational resources and do not replace personalized financial advice.

## Official Site

- [Compounding Journey](https://compoundingjourney.com/)
- [Spanish version](https://compoundingjourney.com/?lang=es)
- [English version](https://compoundingjourney.com/?lang=en)
- [Portuguese version](https://compoundingjourney.com/?lang=pt)

## Main Topics and Tools

- [Financial education pillars](https://compoundingjourney.com/#pilares): money psychology, intentional investing, sustainable habits, and financial freedom.
- [Financial calculators](https://compoundingjourney.com/#herramientas): compound interest, financial freedom, and purchase cost in working hours.
- [Excel templates](https://compoundingjourney.com/#plantillas): free personal budgeting and expense-management resources.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://compoundingjourney.com/#preguntas-frecuentes): direct answers about the 4% rule, compound growth, saving versus investing, financial advisors, the cost-in-hours calculator, investment risk profiles, Excel budget templates, and the educational scope of the content.
- [About Sandy Bradbury](https://compoundingjourney.com/#biografia): the creator's approach to money psychology, financial habits, and diversified investing.
- [Contact](https://compoundingjourney.com/#contacto): questionnaires and a direct contact form.
